section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participant demographics for a single study. The sample consisted of 247 women, with a mean age of 29.76 years. The majority of participants identified as White (66.8%) and were highly educated, with 83.0% having an undergraduate degree or higher. The recruitment method, potentially through a BDSM-related website, led to a high proportion of non-traditional participants regarding sexual orientation and partner status.
